# Town of Marshfield municipal roster backfill -- Vermont
# municipal fan-out batch 14; issue #163 (VT master tracking).

sources.note: Town of Marshfield (official website), Selectboard page: lists the Selectboard as Richard Baker (Chair), Christopher Whalen, and Luke Lampugnale; the Secretary of State's directory publishes no Marshfield roster

Hardwick Gazette, 'Everything Passes at Marshfield Town Meeting' (March 24, 2026), reporting the town's draft annual-meeting minutes officer by officer: Luke Lampugnale was re-elected to the Selectboard in 2026 (three-year term); Justin Campbell retired

Hardwick Gazette, 'Everything Passes at Marshfield Town Meeting' (March 24, 2026), reporting the town's draft annual-meeting minutes officer by officer: Bobbi Brimblecombe was elected Town Clerk at the March 1, 2026 annual meeting (one-year term)
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, and County Officials' (January 2026): names Bobbi Brimblecombe as Marshfield's town clerk
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, town clerk contact spreadsheet (updated June 12, 2026): lists Bobbi Brimblecombe as Marshfield's town clerk

Hardwick Gazette, 'Everything Passes at Marshfield Town Meeting' (March 24, 2026), reporting the town's draft annual-meeting minutes officer by officer: Bobbi Brimblecombe was elected Town Treasurer at the March 1, 2026 annual meeting (one-year term)

Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, and County Officials' (January 2026): names Bobbi Brimblecombe as Marshfield's town treasurer (the treasurer contact spreadsheet carries no Marshfield entry)

Hardwick Gazette, 'Everything Passes at Marshfield Town Meeting' (March 24, 2026), reporting the town's draft annual-meeting minutes officer by officer: Bobbi Brimblecombe was elected Collector of Delinquent Taxes at the March 1, 2026 annual meeting (one-year term)

Hardwick Gazette, 'Everything Passes at Marshfield Town Meeting' (March 24, 2026), reporting the town's draft annual-meeting minutes officer by officer: Michael Caccavo was elected Moderator at the March 1, 2026 annual meeting (one-year term)

Hardwick Gazette, 'Everything Passes at Marshfield Town Meeting' (March 24, 2026), reporting the town's draft annual-meeting minutes officer by officer: Marie Maclay was elected auditor in 2026 (three-year term; the Gazette prints 'Marie Marclay' -- the certified justice of the peace listing's 'Marie Maclay' is the canonical form). The holders of the other two auditor seats are published nowhere reachable, so they are left unfilled

Hardwick Gazette, 'Everything Passes at Marshfield Town Meeting' (March 24, 2026), reporting the town's draft annual-meeting minutes officer by officer: Kathleen Hayes was elected lister in 2026 (three-year term); a second lister seat (two-year remainder) drew no nominations and stands vacant for Selectboard appointment, so it is left unfilled. The Gazette's Selectboard-meeting reporting names 'Listers Meg Eberhardt and Kathleen Hayes' as the sitting board; Eberhardt's full name is Margaret, per the justice of the peace listing

Hardwick Gazette, 'Everything Passes at Marshfield Town Meeting' (March 24, 2026), reporting the town's draft annual-meeting minutes officer by officer: Shawn Codling was elected Constable at the March 1, 2026 annual meeting (one-year term)

Hardwick Gazette, 'Everything Passes at Marshfield Town Meeting' (March 24, 2026), reporting the town's draft annual-meeting minutes officer by officer: Betsy Brigham (five-year term), Amy Monahan (four-year remainder), and Beth Stern (two-year remainder) were elected to the Budget Committee in 2026. The committee's size is DERIVED: one seat is elected each year to a five-year term, so the board numbers five; the 2026 meeting filled the regular five-year seat plus two vacancy remainders. Two seats' holders are unpublished and left unfilled. Marshfield's Amy Monahan is a different person from Cabot's town treasurer Amy Monahan
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Justices of the Peace' listing (updated December 4, 2025): lists seven Marshfield justices of the peace elected November 5, 2024

sources.note: Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Justices of the Peace' listing (updated December 4, 2025): lists seven Marshfield justices of the peace elected November 5, 2024: James Arisman, Margaret Eberhardt, Ellen Halperin, Judy Henkin, Mary Leahy, Marie Maclay, and Michael Sabourin. The listing publishes no vote totals or party labels and none are recorded
